content.text:
All 18 rules reviewed and submitted. Summary of our position:

**Deviations redlined (7)**
- **MINCOMMIT** – §2.1's three-year, USD 2M/year take-or-pay "without reduction or termination rights" narrowed to a 12-month, reducible commitment with a true-up.
- **T4C** – no Customer convenience right anywhere in a three-year term; inserted a new §9.6 (30 days' notice, refund of prepaid Fees, no Vendor convenience right).
- **INDEMN** – the agreement has *no* indemnification section (numbering skips 20, with a dangling reference to "Section 20.5"); inserted our standard Vendor indemnity with procedure, infringement remedies and a narrow Customer indemnity.
- **IP** – §14.2 gave Vendor exclusive ownership of Deliverables with a revocable term licence back; reversed to Customer ownership with a perpetual-licence fallback.
- **NONCOMPETE** – deleted §12.4 (second instance): 24-month, all-territory competition ban.
- **NOSOLICIT** – §12.4 (first instance) 24-month all-employee no-hire narrowed to a mutual 12-month, involved-personnel non-solicit with carve-outs.
- **MFN** – deleted §7.2's disclose-and-match obligation (also cures the de facto right of first refusal).
- **GOVLAW** – §28.1's Singapore law/venue replaced with New York, resolving the conflict with §28.2.

**Compliant (10)** – LOL-CAP (mutual greater-of cap with full Excluded Claims), RENEWAL, ASSIGN, LICENSE, AUDIT, LD, WARRANTY, INSURANCE, EXCLUSIVITY, plus the Customer Data ownership half of §14.

Note for the negotiation: §12.3 already disclaims exclusivity, non-compete, MFN, minimum volume and no-hire, so the deletions above simply make the document internally consistent — a useful framing when we send the markup.
